description: This file defines classes and functions related to Android device automation within the Playwright testing framework, including Android device management, webview handling, and input simulation.

classes.name: Android
classes.description: Represents an Android device controller, capable of connecting to devices, launching servers, and managing Android devices.

classes.name: AndroidDevice
classes.description: Represents an individual Android device, providing methods to interact with webviews, perform input actions, and manage device lifecycle.

classes.name: AndroidSocket
classes.description: Represents a socket connection to an Android device, allowing data transfer and connection management.

classes.name: AndroidInput
classes.description: Provides input simulation methods such as typing, pressing, tapping, and dragging on an Android device.

classes.name: AndroidWebView
classes.description: Represents a webview within an Android device, allowing access to the web page and socket connection.

methods.name: setDefaultTimeout
methods.description: Sets the default timeout for operations on Android or AndroidDevice.

methods.name: devices
methods.description: Retrieves a list of connected Android devices.

methods.name: launchServer
methods.description: Launches an Android server if supported.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to an Android device endpoint.

methods.name: serial
methods.description: Returns the serial number of the Android device.

methods.name: model
methods.description: Returns the model name of the Android device.

methods.name: webViews
methods.description: Returns a list of webviews on the Android device.

methods.name: webView
methods.description: Finds a webview matching the selector or waits for one.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for a specific Android element to meet a condition.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills a text input in the Android device.

methods.name: press
methods.description: Simulates pressing a key on the Android device.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Simulates a tap on the Android device.

methods.name: drag
methods.description: Performs a drag action on the Android device.

methods.name: fling
methods.description: Performs a fling gesture in a direction.

methods.name: longTap
methods.description: Performs a long tap gesture.

methods.name: pinchClose
methods.description: Performs a pinch close gesture.

methods.name: pinchOpen
methods.description: Performs a pinch open gesture.

methods.name: scroll
methods.description: Scrolls in a direction.

methods.name: swipe
methods.description: Swipes in a direction.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Retrieves information about an Android element.

methods.name: screenshot
methods.description: Takes a screenshot of the Android device.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the Android device connection.

methods.name: shell
methods.description: Executes a shell command on the Android device.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a socket connection to the Android device.

methods.name: installApk
methods.description: Installs an APK on the Android device.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes a file to the Android device.

methods.name: launchBrowser
methods.description: Launches a browser context on the Android device.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specific event on the Android device.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the Android socket.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the Android socket connection.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Types text into the Android device.

methods.name: press
methods.description: Presses a key on the Android device.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Taps a point on the Android device.

methods.name: swipe
methods.description: Performs a swipe gesture.

methods.name: drag
methods.description: Performs a drag gesture.

methods.name: toSelectorChannel
methods.description: Converts an AndroidSelector object to a channels.AndroidSelector object.

methods.name: AndroidWebView
methods.description: Represents a webview in an Android device, allowing access to the page and socket.
